title: APEX-05: Arabidopsis spaceflight transcriptomics, root architecture, and ML-based sample quality control
description: FAIR data and analysis package for the Advanced Plant Experiment-05 (APEX-05) spaceflight study of Arabidopsis thaliana. Wild-type Col-0 is compared with reactive-oxygen (rbohD) and calcium-transport (cax22, cax23) signalling mutants under spaceflight (FL) versus ground control (GC), profiling shoot and root transcriptomes (RNA-seq; HISAT2 + edgeR/DESeq2) and root system architecture (RSML/archidart morphometrics). The package includes a reproducible scikit-learn quality-control pipeline that recovers tissue identity from expression (100% leave-one-out accuracy; ~97% recall recovering injected label swaps) and documents the detection and provenance-based resolution of a cax23 adjacent-well sample-labelling anomaly. See docs/PROVENANCE_cax23_mislabelling.md and analysis/ml/.
notes: Raw sequencing reads: NASA OSDR/GeneLab accession TO CONFIRM. Companion npj Microgravity manuscript in manuscript/.
